project_title: BekuMart - Frozen Food POS & ERP Management System

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

desktop.style: Fixed left sidebar with sleek active states, sub-menu support, store quick-selector, and theme toggle at bottom.

mobile.nav_style: Bottom navigation bar (5 quick items) + sliding sheet sidebar drawer for complete menu access.

product_placeholder_strategy.description: User explicitly requested no product images. Use color-coded category badges + category icons inside styled rounded containers.

responsive.layout: On mobile screens, POS cart shifts to a bottom-drawer bar or toggle tab; grid reflows from 1 column on mobile to 3-4 columns on laptop.
responsive.typography: Fluid scaling with rem/em units. Inputs set to 16px font-size to avoid iOS auto-zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure horizontal scroll prevention with overflow-x-hidden on root containers.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44x44px for buttons, quantity counters, and navigation tabs.

pos_module.grid_layout: Responsive product cards (1-col mobile, 2-col tablet, 3-4 col desktop) with instant search, category filters, quick stock indicators.
pos_module.cart_panel: Sticky right sidebar on desktop, collapsible bottom bar / modal sheet on mobile with item count, quantity increment/decrement, clear cart button, subtotal, discount, tax, total, payment modal launcher.
pos_module.checkout_modal: Payment method selection (Tunai, QRIS, Transfer Bank, Debit), nominal calculator buttons (Uang Pas, Rp 50.000, Rp 100.000), change calculator (Kembalian), customer name input.
pos_module.receipt: Printable thermal receipt preview modal formatted for 80mm/58mm thermal printers with store header, itemized list, subtotal, payment detail, footer message, and window.print trigger.

dashboard_module.summary_cards: 7 metrics: Total Penjualan, Total Omzet/Revenue, Jumlah Transaksi, Total Produk, Stok Menipis (Alert), Total Pengeluaran, Estimasi Laba Bersih.
dashboard_module.charts: Interactive charts using Recharts for daily revenue/expense trends and top-selling frozen food products.

inventory_module.stock_adjustment: Modal to adjust stock (Tambah / Kurang / Opname) with reason dropdown (Barang Rusak, Expired, Restock, Koreksi).
inventory_module.stock_history: Audit log table showing stock movement with filter by date, product, and adjustment type.

supplier_price_list_module.features: Compare cost price per product across suppliers, auto calculate profit margin when cost price changes, historical price log.

cashflow_module.features: Auto-calculated income from POS sales + manual entry form for expenses (Listrik freezer, sewa tempat, gaji, operasional) with date filter and category badges.

instructions_to_main_agent: Always wrap interactive elements with data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='pos-product-card-1', data-testid='checkout-button', data-testid='theme-toggle').
Enforce Indonesian language (Bahasa Indonesia) for UI text, labels, status messages, toasts, and buttons.
Format all monetary values with Rupiah format (e.g., 'Rp 35.000').
Never use raw transparent header backgrounds or unstyled dropdowns.
Ensure confirmation modal pops up before deleting products, suppliers, transactions, or expense entries.
Use sonner for notification toasts when actions succeed or fail.
Maintain both light and dark themes using a clean CSS variable or Tailwind 'dark:' class strategy with persistent state in localStorage.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow mobile-first design, high contrast typography, accessible interactive targets, data-testid attributes on all key controls, layered card shadows, and fast touch feedback.
